correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the definition C_{h,p}=sup_{unit u,v, 0<=t<=1} h(N(u+tv),N(u-tv))/||(1,t)||_p. In the exact 8-point dual support geometry, 64 ordered pairs reduce to (2,0),(0,2),(2,2r),(2r,2),(sqrt2,sqrt2) with r=sqrt2-1; all affine envelopes are <=2+2rt on [0,1]. Since harmonic mean <= arithmetic mean, h<=1+rt. The explicit u=(1,r),v=(-r,1) satisfies N(u+tv)=N(u-tv)=1+rt for every t; Holder gives ||(1,r)||_q and t=r^(1/(p-1)); p=1 and infinity endpoints follow separately. Independently recomputed the 64-pair table and sampled 8 witness scales; the continuum proof is the finite exact table plus analytic inequalities, not the grid.
residual_risks: The paper is a fixed two-dimensional real norm calculation; support enumeration must be interpreted algebraically rather than as a floating-point proof.
